`anonymous-case-01.faa` is an unchanged real sequence with its identifying
header removed; its evaluator-only file retains provenance and scientific expectations.

The declared expression panel is explicitly synthetic. It supplies raw points,
a censored observation, two conditions, repeated biological units, different
molecule types and source-declared detection criteria. Its separate evaluator
file must never enter an episode's admitted inputs. This panel exercises a full
autonomous numerical/HPC/parent workflow; it is not evidence of actual biological
expression or a substitute for the real-sequence investigation. The left
feature's declared digest matches case 01's complete residue string.

`selected-region-expression.case.json` asks a separate full-workflow question
about residues [20,40) of the same supplied protein. It reuses the original
synthetic panel; it adds no measurement or biological claim. Its adjacent
evaluator-only file requires actual particular correspondence and parent use
while keeping a whole-feature quantity distinct from a region measurement.
Execution evidence and current status are tracked in the
[central evidence-axis ledger](../../../docs/EVIDENCE_AXIS_LEDGER.md).

`nonidentical-region-expression.case.json` asks about the same selected region
of a different retained real protein sequence, Q9KNH4. Its anonymous header
preserves the complete residue string. The unchanged synthetic measurement
panel and the actual measured-feature reference P0ABA6 are supplied separately.
This exercises correspondence between different molecules and projection into
a selected protein feature; a correspondence cannot turn source measurements
into target or region measurements. Its provenance file describes actual input
origins; its evaluator-only expectations are not episode inputs. No execution
is claimed by preparing this case.

# Genomic-window case

`anonymous-case-02.faa` retains the D5ARG8 sequence from the existing A103
UniProt fixture with only an anonymous header. The reusable
`genomic-presence-case-01.case.json` supplies that query and two real retained
NCBI genomic windows; execution deployment settings are supplied per run.
The original source metadata and hashes remain in
`../a103/real/manifest.json`. These files are retained source data, not fresh
provider acquisitions or independent activity experiments.

The separate `genomic-presence-case-01.expectations.json` is evaluator-only.
The episode must verify actual encoded correspondence, retain weak/alternative
matches and preserve scoped non-detection rather than infer whole-genome
absence. Neither window establishes an experimental sample's origin or a
functional partner requirement. No genomic workflow has run at fixture creation.

The `experimental-reference-01` bundle preserves the actual PMC2223550 source
HTML and its text projection. Its case asks about the assayed molecule while
keeping application to the anonymous target separate. This deliberately tests
useful experimental components with unresolved or conflicting target identity
and shared source representations. The adjacent expectations file is evaluator
only. The bundle contains no prior selections, numerical recipe or assessment;
its files are reusable test inputs. No autonomous case has run at creation.

`locus-rna.case.json` pairs the retained genomic window with explicitly
synthetic gene-ID RNA observations. It exercises reference-locus attribution,
verified encoded-sequence correspondence and a contrasting declared sample
reference. It supplies no transcript sequence, assay genotype, detection
criterion or protein-abundance evidence. The separate evaluator file is not
an episode input. These prepared inputs have not run at creation.

`joined-partner-model-01/case.json` combines an explicitly synthetic
omission/addback assay and matched protein-expression panel with two complete
real reference sequences copied from the retained R. capsulatus translation
annotations. The assay declares its actual modeled role sequences separately
from the original genomic source. These copies are not DNA verification or
biological activity evidence. The case exercises the particular source role,
sequence, genomic component and expression connections together; its separate
expectations file is evaluator only. The reusable preparation script is
`tests/a107_joined_partner_inputs.py`. Preparing it does not establish that the
workflow has run; execution status belongs in the central ledger.
